name: Shackleton crest / near Site 004
site_coordinate_source: Boazman et al., Planetary Science Journal (2022); Site 004 89.78 S, 155.73 W
site_note: Representative published point, not an approved landing zone
representative_point_note: Added by our team: the highest 5 m LOLA cell within 100 m of Site 004's published point, 54 m away and 10.5 m higher. The published point sits in a hollow where nearby ground blocks the Sun and Earth in every direction; this crest shows how much 54 m can change. Not a published site.
terrain_horizon_semantics: Maximum line-of-sight elevation along a ray; lower bound with finite DEM coverage and sampling

quality.caution: Incomplete coverage or limited range can hide higher obstacles; never interpret gaps as clear line of sight

model.moon_fixed_frame: MOON_ME / DE421 (user must verify input DEMs; code cannot verify frame epoch)
model.observer_elevation_reference: height above 1737400 m lunar reference sphere
